name: Atomic file prediction store
description: Keeps one JSON file per scope, written atomically, plus an append-only outcome log, drops expired predictions on load and swallows storage errors so a failure never reaches a turn.
advantages: Durable across restarts and isolated per scope, with no external service. Selected because: fixed in code
disadvantages: Single-host files do not share across machines and need cleanup of old scope files; best-effort swallowing can hide a failing disk.
